title: Incorrect logic for adding OPTIONS method
detail: When provide_automatic_options is False (or None resolved to False), the code adds the OPTIONS method to required_methods. This means that even when automatic OPTIONS is disabled via config or attribute, the route will still get an OPTIONS handler, violating the intended behavior and causing tests expecting 405 to fail.
note: Describes the planted negation: OPTIONS is added when automatic options are off.

title: Inverted wait_ready logic
detail: wait_ready() returns True when data is available and False when the stream is closed. The code returns immediately when data is ready, skipping request handling. It should return only when the stream is closed.
note: Describes the planted negation: it returns as soon as data is ready.

title: Potential IndexError when accessing spans[-1] with empty spans
detail: When a variation selector is processed and there is no previous measured character, the code enters the else block and still accesses spans[-1] without checking if spans is non-empty. If the string starts with a variation selector or contains a variation selector after a zero-width character with no prior span, this will raise an IndexError.
